tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, inputs and the login panel, on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Meter tracks, the destination box in the external link warning, disabled controls.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, metadata and timestamps on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline around cards and between rows. Carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons, meter tracks and dialogs: every edge a person needs to find. 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and the large identity fields. Always paired with on-brand.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Links and quiet buttons on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Always underlined, so Greystone reads without hue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 3px focus ring with a 2px offset, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Icon, text and meter fill for open, approved and public states. Reads on positive-surface, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: positive-surface
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind positive.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Icon, text and meter fill for pending, waiting list and nearly full states. Reads on caution-surface, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: caution-surface
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind caution.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Icon, text and meter fill for full stations, errors and destructive actions. Reads on critical-surface, surface and surface-raised. Fill of the danger button.

tokens.name: critical-surface
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind critical.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a critical fill, such as the danger button.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Icon and text for cancelled, private, unlisted and draft states. Reads on neutral-surface, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: neutral-surface
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind neutral.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Layer behind the external link warning and any other dialog.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Event name at the top of a public event page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and dialog title, station name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Setup starts at 4 pm in the gym.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and emphasis inside body copy.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints, metadata, field labels at weight 600.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: The destination address in the external link warning.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, gap between list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The destination box, small insets.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the login panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and meter tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs above the scrim.
